correctness.rationale: The spherical cosine law for a farthest vertex pair gives sin(rho)=sin(width/2)/cos(pi/(2n)). The generating vertices force any containing ball to have radius at least rho by averaging their Euclidean representatives. Conversely the ball of radius width-rho about the generating center lies in every defining radius-width disk, so the inradius is at least width-rho. Hou–Jin's exact relation r+R=width then gives R at most rho, hence equality. Substitution into their definition cancels the width. The verifier independently checks the spherical geometry over odd n through 63 and multiple widths; the all-parameter proof is analytic.
